name: clean-view
description: Hides tool calls, diffs and command output and shows a plain checklist above the prompt. Needs nothing else; sends a short text to Haiku to name the checklist.

name: idea-shelf
description: Park ideas with /idea and send them to Claude later. Needs nothing else.

name: noticeboard
description: A /board side pane that explains the question at the end of a reply with explorable options. Needs the claude command; herdr is optional.

name: design-direction
description: Shows design-direction options as rendered mockups in the browser. macOS only (uses open).

name: band-frame
description: A top rule and tinted background around the band above the prompt. Needs nothing else.

name: session-peers
description: Records each Claude session in a folder for a pane such as terminal-desk, and warns when two edit the same file. Useful with terminal-desk.

name: strict-guard
description: Allows harmless destructive shell commands and refuses the rest by fixed rules, without asking. Needs git and bash. Apache-2.0.
